svg.title: Aashish Thakuri terminal profile
svg.desc: An expanded developer profile with animated skill symbols beside a living high-density character portrait reconstructed entirely from terminal glyphs.

g.aria-label: slow falling code behind the portrait
profile identity and capabilities written as terminal source
g.text: I see every interface as a piece of art with a purpose.
I love turning symbols, stories, and ideas into visual language,
then building them into websites people can feel and understand.
For me, design is never decoration.
Every line, movement, and interaction should symbolize something
and make the experience more human, memorable, and meaningful.
Technology should not flatten creativity; it should give ideas form.
I build to make difficult systems visible, intuitive, and expressive.
I want every interaction to carry intention, not just function.
GENERATIVE UI / RAG PATTERNS / LIGHTWEIGHT MLOPS
I am exploring how intelligent systems can become useful creative material.
Music and writing keep my imagination moving.
I am always observing, learning, testing, and refining.
Every interface can carry a symbol.
Every interaction can tell part of the story.

g.aria-label: the complete character portrait breathing as one continuous field
soft character light moving through the portrait
terminal fragments moving around the living portrait
